methods.name: create
methods.summary: Submit an abuse report of a particular type.
methods.description:
Submit an abuse report of a particular type.

Requires the abuse-reports entitlement on the account (Enterprise accounts have
it by default; other accounts must request access) and an API token with the
`Account > Abuse Reports > Edit` permission. If the account is not entitled, the
request is rejected with an HTTP `401` response (see below).

type.text: AbuseReportsDmcaReport | AbuseReportsTrademarkReport | AbuseReportsGeneralReport | AbuseReportsPhishingReport | AbuseReportsCsamReport | AbuseReportsThreatReport | AbuseReportsRegistrarWhoisReport | AbuseReportsNcseiReport

props.name: account_id
props.description: Cloudflare Account ID

props.name: act
props.description: The report type for submitted reports.

props.name: address1
props.description:
Text not exceeding 100 characters. This field may be released by
Cloudflare to third parties such as the Lumen Database
(https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: agent_name
props.description:
The name of the copyright holder. Text not exceeding 60 characters.
This field may be released by Cloudflare to third parties such as the Lumen
Database (https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: agree
props.description:
Can be `0` for false or `1` for true. Must be value: 1 for DMCA
reports

props.name: city
props.description:
Text not exceeding 255 characters. This field may be released by
Cloudflare to third parties such as the Lumen Database
(https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: country
props.description:
Text not exceeding 255 characters. This field may be released by
Cloudflare to third parties such as the Lumen Database
(https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: email
props.description:
A valid email of the abuse reporter. This field may be released by
Cloudflare to third parties such as the Lumen Database
(https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: email2
props.description: Should match the value provided in `email`

props.name: host_notification
props.description:
Notification type based on the abuse type. NOTE: Copyright (DMCA)
and Trademark reports cannot be anonymous.

props.name: name
props.description:
Text not exceeding 255 characters. This field may be released by
Cloudflare to third parties such as the Lumen Database
(https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: original_work
props.description:
Text not exceeding 255 characters. This field may be released by
Cloudflare to third parties such as the Lumen Database
(https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: owner_notification
props.description:
Notification type based on the abuse type. NOTE: Copyright (DMCA)
and Trademark reports cannot be anonymous.

props.name: signature
props.description:
Required for DMCA reports, should be same as Name. An affirmation
that all information in the report is true and accurate while agreeing to the
policies of Cloudflare's abuse reports

props.name: state
props.description:
Text not exceeding 255 characters. This field may be released by
Cloudflare to third parties such as the Lumen Database
(https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: urls
props.description:
A list of valid URLs separated by ‘\n’ (new line character). The
list of the URLs should not exceed 250 URLs. All URLs should have the same
hostname. Each URL should be unique. This field may be released by Cloudflare to
third parties such as the Lumen Database (https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: comments
props.description:
Any additional comments about the infringement not exceeding 2000
characters

props.name: company
props.description:
Text not exceeding 100 characters. This field may be released by
Cloudflare to third parties such as the Lumen Database
(https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: reported_country
props.description: Text containing 2 characters

props.name: reported_user_agent
props.description: Text not exceeding 255 characters

props.name: tele
props.description:
Text not exceeding 20 characters. This field may be released by
Cloudflare to third parties such as the Lumen Database
(https://lumendatabase.org/).

props.name: title
props.description: Text not exceeding 255 characters

props.name: justification
props.description:
A detailed description of the infringement, including any necessary
access details and the exact steps needed to view the content, not exceeding
5000 characters.

props.name: trademark_number
props.description: Text not exceeding 1000 characters

props.name: trademark_office
props.description: Text not exceeding 1000 characters

props.name: trademark_symbol
props.description: Text not exceeding 1000 characters

props.name: destination_ips
props.description:
A list of IP addresses separated by ‘\n’ (new line character). The
list of destination IPs should not exceed 30 IP addresses. Each one of the IP
addresses ought to be unique.

props.name: ports_protocols
props.description:
A comma separated list of ports and protocols e.g. 80/TCP, 22/UDP.
The total size of the field should not exceed 2000 characters. Each individual
port/protocol should not exceed 100 characters. The list should not have more
than 30 unique ports and protocols.

props.name: source_ips
props.description:
A list of IP addresses separated by ‘\n’ (new line character). The
list of source IPs should not exceed 30 IP addresses. Each one of the IP
addresses ought to be unique.

props.name: ncmec_notification
props.description:
Notification type based on the abuse type. NOTE: Copyright (DMCA)
and Trademark reports cannot be anonymous.

props.name: reg_who_request
reg_who_good_faith_affirmation
props.description: Affirmation that the request is made in good faith per RDP 10.2.4. Must be true.

props.name: reg_who_lawful_processing_agreement
props.description: Agreement to process data lawfully per RDP 10.2.5. Must be true.

props.name: reg_who_legal_basis
props.description:
Legal rights and rationale for the request per RDP 10.2.3. Required for all
WHOIS requests.

props.name: reg_who_request_type
props.description: The type of WHOIS data request per RDP procedure.

props.name: reg_who_requested_data_elements
props.description:
The specific WHOIS data elements being requested per RDP 10.2.2. Required for
all WHOIS requests.

props.name: reg_who_authorization_statement
props.description: Optional authorization statement or power of attorney per RDP 10.2.1.3.

props.name: reg_who_requestor_type
props.description: The nature of the requestor per RDP 10.2.1.2.
RDP-mandated fields for registrar WHOIS data disclosure requests.

props.name: ncsei_subject_representation
props.description:
If the submitter is the target of NCSEI in the URLs of the abuse
report.
